original_bug_description: Heap-buffer-overflow in BMP parsing: bmp_read_image (load-bmp.c) can read past the end of the allocated image/palette buffer when handling crafted BMP files, causing a heap out-of-bounds read. This can lead to crashes, potential information disclosure, or other memory-corruption impacts when decoding BMP images (seen via fz_load_bmp_subimage / img_load_page).
normalized_bug_description: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=6152264944058368: mupdf has a reported memory-safety bug. Heap-buffer-overflow in BMP parsing: bmp_read_image (load-bmp.c) can read past the end of the allocated image/palette buffer when handling crafted BMP files, causing a heap out-of-bounds read. This can lead to crashes, potential information disclosure, or other memory-corruption impacts when decoding BMP images (seen via fz_load_bmp_subimage / img_load_page).
